About us

 Orange Beach Private Fishing Charters with Cool Change Charters

Book your unforgettable private fishing trip in Orange Beach or Gulf Shores, Alabama today!

Looking for the best private fishing charter in Orange Beach? Whether you’re after offshore deep sea fishing, inshore adventures, or a family-friendly trolling trip, Captain Joe Nash and the experienced crew at Cool Change Charters have you covered. With over 30 years of professional guiding experience, Captain Joe knows how to put you on the fish—and create memories that last a lifetime.

BOOK ONLINE now

Family Fishing Packages in Orange Beach

CAPTAIN JOE NASH – COOL CHANGE 2

Your Orange Beach Captain

 Meet Capt. Joe Nash – Your Trusted Orange Beach Fishing Guide

Captain Joe Nash is a seasoned outdoorsman with a lifelong passion for both hunting and fishing. With over 35 years of experience fishing the Gulf waters of Orange Beach and Gulf Shores, Capt. Joe is one of the most knowledgeable and respected private fishing charter captains on the Alabama coast. Alongside his wife Cindy, an avid fisherwoman herself, the Nash family is committed to creating unforgettable saltwater adventures for anglers of all ages and experience levels.

BOOK ONLINE now

 A Proven Leader in Gulf Coast Fishing

With over 5,000 paid fishing charters under his belt and a U.S. Coast Guard license since 1982, Capt. Joe has guided thousands of happy customers through the inshore bays, nearshore reefs, and deep Gulf waters. Whether you’re chasing Red Snapper, King Mackerel, or Speckled Trout, you’re in expert hands.

 Why Fish With Capt. Joe?

 Over 35 years of Gulf Coast charter experience

 Local expert on Orange Beach and Gulf Shores fishing

 Fun, patient, and great with first-time anglers

 Fully licensed & insured

 Member of the Orange Beach Chamber of Commerce (18+ years)

 Member of NACO (National Association of Charter Operators)

 Member of OBFA (Orange Beach Fisherman’s Association)

BOOK ONLINE now

 A Word from Capt. Joe“Hi, I’m Capt. Joe Nash. I’ve been fishing Orange Beach since 1987 and I’ve seen just about everything these waters can offer. I’ve taken thousands of people fishing from first-timers to seasoned pros—and I still get a thrill every time someone hooks into a big one. First-timers are my favorite to watch, and I always enjoy the ‘excuses’ from the veterans when a fish gets the best of them.Come spend a day with us at Cool Change Charters and experience the fun, challenge, and excitement of Gulf Coast fishing. Let’s go make some memories!” Book Your Orange Beach Charter TodayIf you’re searching for experienced, local fishing guides in Orange Beach, look no further than Capt. Joe Nash at Cool Change Charters. Call or text (251) 979-1812 to reserve your next private deep sea or inshore fishing adventure!

Don’t Miss You’re Chance To Fish With The Best!

Easy secure booking online!
